title: ExtractionOutput
description: The shape every row returned by an 'extract' node must match before being written to ResultRow. Validate in code — source_url is non-negotiable.

fields.description: Arbitrary key/value pairs matching the entities_to_extract from the workflow plan, e.g. { "company_name": "...", "website": "..." }.

source_url.description: Required. Where this row's data was found. A row without this is invalid and must not be persisted.

confidence.description: Model's confidence that the extracted fields are accurate and complete.
